endpoints.purpose: Register a new user account with email and password
Authenticate user and return JWT access + refresh tokens
Create a new project within an organization
Retrieve a project and its latest blueprint
Submit an idea and trigger multi-agent blueprint generation
Re-run a specific agent to regenerate one blueprint section
Export the full blueprint as a downloadable PDF
List recent agent execution history with performance metrics
System health check for uptime monitoring

scalability.scaling: Horizontal auto-scaling with ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. Target: 50ms p95 latency up to 10k concurrent users. Agent workers scale independently based on SQS queue depth.
scalability.caching: Redis cluster for session management, rate limiting, and caching generated blueprints. TTL-based invalidation with cache-aside pattern. Expected 85% cache hit rate on repeated blueprint views.
scalability.infrastructure: Multi-AZ deployment across us-east-1. RDS PostgreSQL with read replicas for analytics queries. S3 for blob storage with CloudFront CDN. Infrastructure as Code via Terraform modules.
